# API

JSON API prefix: /api/v1. Errors use {error:{code,message,details}}; validation returns 422 field details. Lists use opaque cursor pagination.

POST /auth/signup accepts name/email/password (at least 10 characters). POST /auth/login accepts email/password. POST /auth/logout revokes the current session. GET /me returns user and auth kind. GET /health returns ok.

Cookie mutations require X-Crew-Request: 1. Bearer tokens are handled by people authentication. Per-lane endpoint guides are linked here as implemented.

[Organizations, teams, shared permission service and outbox schema](api-people.md).
